---
title: "Penguin Lab"
---

Welcome. This is a small site about the **Palmer penguins** — three species measured at Palmer
Station, Antarctica, and shipped in base R as `datasets::penguins` (R ≥ 4.5).

Head to the **[analysis](analysis.qmd)** for the figures and a summary table.

> This is the finished **Website Challenge** project — the `.qmd` pages from `day2-projects/`, plus the
> `_quarto.yml` and `_brand.yml` that make them a navigable, branded website. Open it to compare, or
> use it as the ready starting point for the **Ship it Challenge**.
